question_text: Describe, without code, how to insert a new uniquely named client into an alphabetically ordered singly linked list. Include empty-list and head-insertion cases; preserve existing order.
adaptation_rationale: Repairs source figure’snot-actually-ordered list by explicitly assuming sorted input; preserves algorithmic insertion reasoning.
solution: Create the new node containing the client record.; Start current at head with previous unset.; Move through smaller names, keeping previous, until the first larger name or end.; Set new.next to current.; If previous exists, set previous.next to new; otherwise update head to new, also handling an empty list.
